args.lesson: What worked: porting reconcile.py to a stdlib-free JS core with a small custom JSON parser kept Python int/float types (1000.0) and gave a canonical hash and text output byte-identical to Python on 11 cases (33/33). The actual inline page script under a Node vm DOM stub also matched Python, with no network calls (15/15). Dry_run digest a0dd85c3. What failed: one EXEC argv went over 8192 chars, and one EXEC skipped mkdir. Keep each heredoc under about 7 KB and mkdir in every EXEC. Next time, aim for exact text parity from the start; it is a stronger check than field-by-field comparison. Limits: no real browser, so it is untested there. This is synthetic, not demand.
